CustomField.description: Plain-text status of each color (Done / Skipped / Active / Pending) for list views and reports. The record page shows the same information with icons.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Color_Review_Stage__c, "Not Started"), "Not started", "Pink: " & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Pink_Completed_Date__c)), "Done", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 1, "Skipped", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c = 1, "Active", "Pending"))) & " | " & "Red: " & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Red_Completed_Date__c)), "Done", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 2, "Skipped", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c = 2, "Active", "Pending"))) & " | " & "Blue: " & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Blue_Completed_Date__c)), "Done", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 3, "Skipped", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c = 3, "Active", "Pending"))) & " | " & "Gold: " & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Gold_Completed_Date__c)), "Done", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 4, "Skipped", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c = 4, "Active", "Pending"))) & " | " & "Green: " & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Green_Completed_Date__c)), "Done", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c > 5, "Skipped", IF(Color_Review_Stage_Order__c = 5, "Active", "Pending"))))
CustomField.label: Color Review Summary
